ov: A highly venomous tree snake of sub-Saharan Africa; its name is Afrikaans for "tree snake". It has very large eyes and excellent eyesight. Males are usually light green, while females may be brown. It is timid, and bites mostly happen when people try to catch or kill it.

why.dg: A tiny dose of its venom can kill an adult, but it is timid: bites usually happen when people try to handle or catch it.

df: Chameleons and other tree lizards, frogs, and sometimes small mammals, birds and eggs.
fx: Herpetologist Karl Schmidt died in 1957 after a bite from a young boomslang he doubted could kill him.
Its venom is slow-acting, so symptoms may not appear until many hours after a bite.
